mutant.description: THE LOAD-BEARING CLAIM is an ABSENCE OF EFFECT -- that the forcing does not change the verdict -- and an absence of effect is trivially produced by a broken harness that never applied the forcing at all. So the harness carries its own POSITIVE ARM: the SAME fixture, the SAME month, the SAME probe and the SAME served renderer, run with ladder=False, must produce the REFUSE the ladder path fails to produce. If both arms read PUBLISH the harness is the defect and the claim is void.
